summary.text: Lucas Herring is a candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Washington-1 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, appearing under both the Republican and Democratic party labels after advancing from both primaries on August 11, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Lucas Herring ran for the same two-seat district in 2024 as a Democrat and lost the general election, receiving 1,173 votes (16.5%) behind incumbents Anne Donahue and Kenneth Goslant.
In the 2026 Republican primary he received 209 votes, and Ballotpedia lists incumbent Kenneth Goslant and Herring as the candidates in the general election.
